records.title: WORK AT VIJAYAWADA AIRPORT
details:
Regarding Kolkata, the need is there. If the land is available, if the State
also supports for the construction, and if the connectivity between the two
locations is possible, then definitely we are going to take it up positively. I
would request him that we will definitely meet up after the Session also. We
can have a special meeting regarding the Kolkata airport and the development
of the new terminal.
